newsitem.title: DENMARK: CYCLING-LOMBARDI WINS DENMARK TOUR SECOND STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-LOMBARDI WINS DENMARK TOUR SECOND STAGE.

text.p: Italy's Giovanni Lombardi won the 169-km second stage of the Tour of Denmark cycle race on Thursday but missed the leader's yellow jersey by a second.
Australian Robbie McEwen finished second to take the overall lead from Italian overnight leader Nicola Minali.

After five hot hours from the cathedral town of Ribe through the flatlands of south Jutland, Lombardi broke clear from the pack in Soenderborg, facing off a late challenge from Denmark's Lars Michaelsen to snatch victory.
McEwen passed the Dane in the last spurt of the stage, coming second for the second successive day.
He trailed Lombardi by four seconds in the stage but was a second ahead overall with a time of seven hours 45 minutes 16 seconds.
Lombardi's compatriot Fabrizio Guidi, winner of last year's Tour of Denmark, came fourth but was third overall.
